scope: Selected actual pre-port road sweep curves and original upper stencils, one acquired source region; no whole-world, final-contact, material or runtime admission
selection: 1024 lowest original-schema full-record SHA256 values plus64 largest each curvature/slope/slope-rate/bank/bank-rate/stations/half-width, and12 parameter-overlay witnesses; retained original capture ordinals, no source deduplication
upper_axes: Float32 rings of4XYZ vertices: east/up/south relative to first reference pose; actual emitted positions/normals before external port stitching and final whole-world transforms
source_identity: Native capture ordinal only; OSM way IDs/material families/end-port recipes are not supplied by this base-curve observer. This is a method fixture, not a production asset schema.
attribution: Procedural curves derived from OpenStreetMap data via OpenFreeMap, with Mapterhorn elevations. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL1.0; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Source provider records remain in original acquisition caches.
intervals: One record per consecutive seams: range_m, midpoint pose using seam_columns, and native MaxAbsCurvaturePerM on that interval. Midpoint avoids ambiguous curvature-rate sidedness at plan seams. The bound covers reference-line plan curvature only, not the swept surface or final contacts.
